faqs.question: What is TradeDay?
faqs.answer: TradeDay is a Chicago futures proprietary trading firm founded in 2020 by James Thorpe and Steve Miley and operated by TradeDay LLC at 412 S. Wells. Traders pass a single-phase evaluation (Quick Pay is the core product) on $50,000, $100,000 or $150,000 accounts, then trade a Funded Sim book and, after a $10,000 gross-profit review, can move into Funded Live. Permitted products are listed CME, CBOT, NYMEX and COMEX futures only.

seo.title: What is TradeDay? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: TradeDay is a Chicago futures prop firm founded in 2020, with $50K–$150K Quick Pay evaluations and a path from Funded Sim to Funded Live.

faqs.question: What is the TradeDay profit split?
faqs.answer: On Quick Pay Funded Sim, splits are calculated per account from current profit. Profit withdrawn while leaving more than $4,000 in the account pays 80/20. Anything that would take remaining current profit below $4,000 pays 50/50, and a request that crosses the line is split proportionally. Funded Live withdrawals pay 90/10. Splits are not a lifetime 80/90/95 ladder across all accounts.

seo.title: TradeDay Profit Split: 50/50, 80% Sim, 90% Live | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Quick Pay Funded Sim pays 80% above $4,000 current profit and 50/50 below it. Funded Live pays 90/10.

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout from TradeDay?
faqs.answer: Quick Pay Funded Sim has no payout buffer and no funded consistency rule. You can request after one funded trading day whenever the balance is above the starting size, with a $250 minimum. Fast Pass instead needs five profitable days and net profit since the last payout. Requests in before 5:30pm CT are processed within 24 hours on business days. Funded Live traders email fundedtrader@tradeday.com rather than using the dashboard button.

seo.metaDescription: Quick Pay allows a payout after one funded day with a $250 minimum. Requests before 5:30pm CT process the next business day.

faqs.question: Which withdrawal methods does TradeDay support, and are there fees?
faqs.answer: All cash leaves through Riseworks after TradeDay sends the onboarding invite. US bank wires are free, international wires cost $15, L2 crypto is free, and L1 crypto costs $2.50 plus gas. TradeDay itself does not add a withdrawal fee. Do not create a standalone Riseworks account before the invite — you must join as part of the TradeDay team.

faqs.question: How do TradeDay drawdown and the Funded Live path work?
faqs.answer: Quick Pay evaluations use a trailing max drawdown of $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500 on the 50K / 100K / 150K sizes, a 5-day minimum, a 30% best-day cap, and no daily loss limit. Funded Sim switches to an intraday trailing drawdown on gross profits (current profit plus payouts already taken), so the trail keeps moving after you withdraw. At $10,000 gross profit the sim account pauses for a Funded Live review; profit above that level is stripped and not paid. Funded Live then pays 90/10 with a maximum of 5 live accounts.
